book_name: 巴山奇象白蚁 Mironasutitermes bashanensis
distribution: 陕西镇坪大巴山北坡浪河口。
en: This soldier resembles the large form of its relatives but is slightly paler, with the nasus and the front margin of the pronotum darker than the rest. The front margin of the pronotum is almost without a median depression while the hind margin is shallowly concave. Mandibles are short and their teeth inconspicuous. The host plant recorded for the species is Castanea mollissima, and it is known from the northern slope of the Daba Mountains in southern Shaanxi.
soldier: 头部与触角均呈褐色，象鼻以及前胸背板前缘的颜色也较深，腹部各节色泽浅淡。体形与大型兵蚁相似，只是色泽稍浅；前胸背板的前缘中央几乎不见凹陷，后缘中央则微凹入；上颚短小，齿突不明显。
taxonomy_note: 原书置于奇象白蚁属 Mironasutitermes，现归入象白蚁属 Nasutitermes。
